claims.value: BMDC_<strain>_<time>m_Rep<k>[_LS]_{infected|mock} — one infected and one mock source per MaxQuant experiment (= one SILAC digest)
claims.evidence: 18 MaxQuant experiments in experimentalDesignTemplate.txt / summary.txt (WT and DsbA x 10/30/60 min x 3 replicates). Paper: 'SILAC experiments were performed in biological triplicate for each time point and bacterial strain used and the respective mock-treated BMDCs served as a control ... In total, 18 digests (three time points/two bacterial strains/triplicate) were fractionated by HILIC. Aliquots of 6 digests (60 min p.i./two bacterial strains/triplicate) were also subjected to proteome analysis.' Each digest = one light + one heavy lysate mixed 1:1, so each digest contributes two physical samples. The replicate tags in the names are the authors' MaxQuant experiment names (10 min replicates are named Rep2, Rep3_LS, Rep4 by the authors). Row ranges: BMDC_WT_10m_Rep2_infected: rows 1-20; BMDC_WT_10m_Rep2_mock: rows 21-40; BMDC_WT_10m_Rep3_LS_infected: rows 41-60; BMDC_WT_10m_Rep3_LS_mock: rows 61-80; BMDC_WT_10m_Rep4_infected: rows 81-100; BMDC_WT_10m_Rep4_mock: rows 101-120; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep2_infected: rows 121-140; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep2_mock: rows 141-160; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep3_LS_infected: rows 161-179; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep3_LS_mock: rows 180-198; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep4_infected: rows 199-217; BMDC_DsbA_10m_Rep4_mock: rows 218-236; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep1_infected: rows 237-256; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep1_mock: rows 257-276; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 277-296; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 297-316; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep3_infected: rows 317-336; BMDC_WT_30m_Rep3_mock: rows 337-356; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep1_infected: rows 357-376; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep1_mock: rows 377-396; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 397-416; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 417-436; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep3_infected: rows 437-456; BMDC_DsbA_30m_Rep3_mock: rows 457-476; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep1_infected: rows 477-496; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep1_mock: rows 497-516; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 517-536; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 537-556; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep3_infected: rows 557-576; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep3_mock: rows 577-596; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep1_infected: rows 597-616; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep1_mock: rows 617-636; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 637-656; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 657-676; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep3_infected: rows 677-696; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep3_mock: rows 697-716.

claims.value: non-LS experiments: infected = SILAC light, mock = SILAC heavy; *_LS experiments: infected = SILAC heavy, mock = SILAC light
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "'light' cells were infected ... 'Heavy' cells were left as control/untreated groups. The whole experiment was done in biological triplicate with one label swap experiment (raw files containing 'LS' in name)." Paper: 'In two replicates, light BMDCs were infected and heavy cells were mock-treated. In one replicate, SILAC groups were swapped.' MaxQuant summary.txt: every non-LS experiment Labels0 '' / Labels1 'Arg6;Lys6', every LS experiment Labels0 'Arg6;Lys6' / Labels1 '' (paper: labels set 'in light channel for label-swap experiments to obtain inverted H/L ratios'), so MaxQuant 'H/L' = mock/infected in all experiments. Data check (erk_sites.txt): log2 'Ratio H/L normalized' of activation-loop sites at WT 60 min: p38 (Mapk14) T180 -0.71/-0.46(LS)/-0.69, ERK2 (Mapk1) Y185 -0.29/-0.20(LS)/-0.38, ERK1 (Mapk3) Y205 -0.32/-0.42(LS)/-0.32 -> higher phosphorylation in the infected channel in both orientations, matching the paper's ERK/p38 activation at 60 min; the LS experiments agree only with the physical swap. Host protein ratio correlations LS vs non-LS are negative (-0.22 to -0.65) because of label-specific bias (paper: 'suboptimal SILAC labeling efficiency of primary BMDCs ... led to the low correlation of label swap replicates'), non-LS vs non-LS positive (+0.32 to +0.52).

claims.value: infected sources 1-3 within each (strain, time) group; mock sources 1-6 within each time group (WT-paired 1-3, DsbA-paired 4-6)
claims.evidence: Paper: biological triplicate per time point and strain, each with its respective mock-treated control; each of the 18 digests contains its own mock lysate. Numbering restarts per factor-value group (spec README.adoc:330). Whether the WT- and DsbA-paired mocks of the same replicate came from one split mock culture is not stated (supplemental Fig. S1 not retrieved), so each mock lysate is counted as its own culture.
Mock-infected BMDCs are the controls ('Mock-infected BMDCs were centrifuged without bacteria'). PRIDE:0001013 study sample / PRIDE:0001014 control sample, children of PRIDE:0000895.
